title: Patient Payment Plan Tier Chart: Balance Bands and Enrollment Channels
content:
Each tier of the Patient Payment Plan admits an enrolled balance within its own band. The smallest figure is the least total balance the tier may enroll; the largest figure is the most the tier may hold in total, add-ons included. Both figures are in US dollars to the cent.

## Tier chart

| Tier | Smallest enrolled balance (USD) | Largest balance held, add-ons included (USD) | Patient portal self-enrollment without a financial counselor | Approved Patient Hardship Discount Program determination required to enroll | Credit check at enrollment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan | 75.00 | 600.00 | Yes | No | No |
| Standard 6-Month Payment Plan | 250.00 | 1500.00 | Yes | No | No |
| Extended 10-Month Payment Plan | 750.00 | 3000.00 | No | No | No |
| Long-Term 12-Month Payment Plan | 1500.00 | 5000.00 | No | No | No |
| Large-Balance 18-Month Payment Plan | 2500.00 | 8000.00 | No | No | No |
| Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan | 200.00 | 8000.00 | No | Yes | No |

The Extended 10-Month, Long-Term 12-Month and Large-Balance 18-Month Payment Plans are enrolled with a financial counselor. The Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan is open only to a patient holding an approved Patient Hardship Discount Program determination.

## Reading the chart

- **Do the bands overlap?** Yes. A hypothetical enrolled balance of 1200.00 lies inside the bands of the Standard 6-Month Payment Plan (250.00 to 1500.00), the Extended 10-Month Payment Plan (750.00 to 3000.00) and the Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan (200.00 to 8000.00).
- **Are the end figures inside the band?** Yes. A hypothetical balance of exactly 600.00 is the most a Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan may hold; 600.01 is above it. A hypothetical balance of exactly 75.00 is the least that tier may enroll; 74.99 is below it.
- **Which tiers run a credit check?** None of the six tiers.
- **Which tiers accept enrollment through the patient portal?** The Short-Term 3-Month and Standard 6-Month Payment Plans only.
